name: scrubber

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the Radius track filled with its tick marks and 55 readout as the shape rounds.

tagline: Four labelled tracks you drag to scrub values, with ticks and a live number.
summary: A compact stack of horizontal sliders where each label sits inside its track. Dragging along the bar changes the value in steps, with tick marks and a readout, and a preview shape reacts.
appearance: On a near-black stage a small grey panel titled 'LAYER · HERO SHAPE' stacks four rounded tracks labelled Opacity, Radius, Rotation and Blur. Each track has its label at the left, faint ticks across the middle, a slim vertical thumb and a monospaced number at the right.
behaviour: Pressing and dragging along a track moves the thumb and updates the number, snapping to the step, while a gradient square on the left changes corner radius, tilt or blur. Hovering or dragging swells and brightens the thumb.
demo_content: Panel 'LAYER · HERO SHAPE' with Opacity, Radius, Rotation and Blur controls, beside a purple-to-orange gradient square.
search_phrases: design tool value slider with label inside
drag a bar to change a number
slider with tick marks and readout
use_when: A settings panel needs several numeric values adjusted quickly by dragging, the way design tools treat opacity.
avoid_when: Fine control is limited to the step and there is no text entry, so exact values are easiest set with arrow keys.
customise: Label, min, max, step, decimals, tick count, controlled value and change callback are props; track height, colours and the thumb spring are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A few divs and one motion thumb per control; no loop runs at rest.

a11y.note: Keyboard and aria values are handled, but there is no aria-valuetext, so the formatted number is only visible on screen.

issues: The values sit in small monospaced text on a compact panel, so they are hard to read at a glance.
polish_why: Coherent design-tool styling and smooth drag feedback; the text is small and the preview is generic.
